intro.title: A Calm & Refined Sanctuary in the Heart of the Aegean
intro.p1: Nourla Boutique Hotel was born in Urla, where warm Aegean breezes meet centuries-old olive orchards. Our architectural restoration harmonizes traditional stonework with modern minimalism and Mediterranean warmth.
intro.p2: With only 10 individually designed suites, we offer our guests more than a stay: an elevated lifestyle rhythm that restores the senses, integrated with gastronomy and nature.

featured_rooms.title: 10 Exclusively Crafted Luxury Suites
featured_rooms.subtitle: Natural textures, custom linens, and serene Mediterranean views.

experience.title: Refined Details to Soothe Your Soul
experience.wine_desc: Sample rare vintages crafted from Urla's ancient vineyards under expert sommelier guidance.
experience.gastro_desc: Olive-oil infused Aegean delicacies and gourmet breakfasts prepared with morning-picked organic produce.
experience.spa_desc: Rejuvenate with bespoke therapy sessions infused with Aegean olive oil and wild lavender extracts.
